item.title: Launch of the Global Gender Snapshot 2026: Progress on the Sustainable Development Goals
item.description: Publication and press briefing on 15 September 2026: The latest annual flagship gender data report analyzing indicators across all 17 Sustainable Development Goals, spotlighting global poverty and care burdens.
